⬛ Overview · 🟪 AI Agents · 🟦 AI Models & Labs · 🟧 AI Policy · 🟨 Data Engineering

Vendor items: 12 | Also new: 5 | Projects: 26 | Active today: 2 | Stable releases: 1 | Prereleases (not covered): 1 | Generated: 2026-11-12 06:59 UTC

Highlights

  • Azure Databricks workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled will have external access to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables enabled by default on or after December 10, 2026; plan for external Delta clients to create, read, and write managed tables.
  • BigQuery Enterprise and Enterprise Plus users can now specify an optional principal property on reservation assignments (generally available) to route queries by user, service account, or third-party identity.
  • Fabric Warehouse CI/CD (preview) adds DacFx schema deployment, pre- and post-deployment scripts, and Warehouse Item Definition APIs for a more complete lifecycle.

Action required

2026-11-30 Azure Databricks Upcoming end of life for the Genie One MCP Beta endpoint The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint at https://<workspace-hostname>/api/2.0/mcp/genie reaches end of life on November 30, 2026, after which requests fail; migrate all workloads to the system.ai.genie_one_mcp MCP in Unity Gateway.
2027-01-31 BigQuery Starting January 31, 2027, the BigQuery Data Transfer Service for Shopify connector will no longer support the following fields Starting January 31, 2027, the BigQuery Data Transfer Service for Shopify connector will drop support for the legacyMode field in the DeliveryProfile dataset schema and the permitSkuSharing field in the FulfillmentService dataset schema.

Databricks

2026-11-10 🤖 Text and binary inputs for protobuf requests to custom model serving endpoints (Public Preview) Protobuf requests to custom model serving endpoints can carry text and binary data as KServe v2 BYTES tensors alongside numeric tensors, with text and binary outputs returned as BYTES tensors; this is only available on endpoints deployed after November 10, 2026.
2026-11-09 🤖 Use cleaned AI answers in Lakeflow Designer (Public Preview) Supported AI Function outputs in Lakeflow Designer can be cleaned for downstream transformations, with cleaned results including answer values, error messages, and raw responses in separate columns.
2026-11-06 Distinguish Lakeflow Designer Python previews from full runs (Public Preview) Python operators in Lakeflow Designer now expose config["is_preview"] so code can skip side effects during previews.

Also new: Azure Databricks Genie plugin for Microsoft 365 Copilot (Public Preview) · Bring your own ChatGPT subscription to Codex with Unity Gateway · Allow ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms in context-based ingress policies · Calculate across rows in Lakeflow Designer (Public Preview)

Databricks CLI

  • Release: v1.26.0 fixes explicit false values on optional boolean bundle fields being dropped, which hid them from bundle validate -o json and prevented targets from overriding true with false; it also stops sending compute_size in the app update mask when undeclared, preventing a deploy from resetting a manually resized app to the default size.
  • Release: Adds the feature_specs resource type with Unity Catalog grants, extends lifecycle.depends_on to target grants or permissions (e.g., schemas.foo.grants), and introduces DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_INIT_WORKSPACE_HOST_PROFILE to control the host returned by the workspace_host template helper.
  • Release: air run now reuses its existing workspace connection for config validation instead of opening a second one, saving a TCP and TLS handshake per submission, and parallelizes archive compression for git-pinned code_source snapshots to speed up packaging on large repositories.

Azure / Fabric & GCP

2026-11-09 🤖 Genie Ontology is now generally available Genie Ontology provides a business-aware context layer for Genie One, Genie Code, and other AI agents by combining modeled knowledge from Unity Catalog semantics with learned knowledge extracted from assets and usage.
2026-11-09 Shift dates in Lakeflow Jobs parameters with date arithmetic (Beta) Lakeflow Jobs parameters now support date arithmetic in dynamic value references, allowing expressions like {{(job.start_time - 1.day).iso_date}} to shift dates by a duration before formatting.
2026-11-07 Recover dropped Unity Catalog volumes with UNDROP VOLUME Dropped Unity Catalog volumes can be recovered within 7 days using SHOW VOLUMES DROPPED to find the ID and UNDROP VOLUME WITH ID to restore privileges and tags, requiring Databricks Runtime 19 or above.
2026-11-06 🤖 Load Unity Catalog tables into PyTorch on AI Runtime (Beta) UCDataset streams Unity Catalog table rows directly into PyTorch training loops on AI Runtime without Spark or a SQL warehouse, applying filter expressions and deletion vectors while splitting rows across GPUs and data loader workers.
2026-11-03 Databricks SQL version 2026.45 is now available in Preview Databricks SQL 2026.45 Preview adds WITH HISTORY and WITHOUT HISTORY clauses to ALTER SHARE... ADD VIEW and ALTER SHARE... ALTER VIEW for controlling view history sharing.

  • Release: v1.25.0 removes CRITICAL as a valid compute.priority_class value; the AI Runtime API no longer accepts it.
  • Release: Fixes %pip in Jupyter notebooks over databricks ssh connect on serverless envs 5/6 and recent Databricks Runtime, which fell back to stock IPython magic; also fixes bundle grants/permissions staying under old names/IDs after resource rename/recreate, and registered model aliases now apply on deploy instead of being ignored.
  • Release: Adds postgres_data_apis resource (Private Preview) for Lakebase Postgres Data API, more specific error_category for databricks aitools install --output json, and templates now embed workspace ID (?w=) in workspace.host for multi-workspace hosts.

Terraform provider for Databricks

  • Release: v1.142.0 adds databricks_connection.secrets for Unity Catalog secrets, new LakeWatch resources (databricks_lakewatch_datasource, databricks_lakewatch_rule, etc.), and Slack/Teams blocks for databricks_notification_destination.
  • Release: Fixes data races in concurrent provider client caches and preserves databricks_pipeline.expected_last_modified on refresh to prevent post-apply drift.

Quiet today: Delta Lake, delta-rs, Unity Catalog, MLflow, dbt-databricks

Snowflake

2026-11-08 🤖 CoCo Admin in Snowsight (Preview) CoCo Admin in Snowsight automatically detects CoCo enablement status and identifies the exact remaining setup steps instead of requiring a manual checklist.
2026-11-06 🤖 Anthropic Claude 5.5 and OpenAI GPT-6 models (General availability) Anthropic Claude 5.5 and OpenAI GPT-6 models are now generally available in Snowflake.

Also new: Snowflake CoCo for Microsoft Excel and Snowflake CoCo for Google Sheets (Preview) · Skill recommendations and suggestions to create and share skills in CoCo

Date Source Item Summary

2026-11-09 BigQuery Query performance troubleshooting and job and system performance comparison in the BigQuery jobs explorer (GA) BigQuery jobs explorer now provides generally available query performance troubleshooting and job and system performance comparison capabilities.
2026-11-09 BigQuery When you create or schedule a pipeline, you can specify the maximum number of concurrently executed pipeline tasks (GA) BigQuery pipelines support specifying the maximum number of concurrently executed pipeline tasks at creation or scheduling time.

  • AI model serving advances on Databricks and Snowflake: Databricks Smart Routing (Beta) now routes subagents only, cutting cost up to 70% and p90 latency from 9s to 2s, while Snowflake makes Anthropic Claude 5.5 and OpenAI GPT-6 generally available for Cortex workloads.
  • Cost attribution appears on Databricks and BigQuery: Databricks Smart Routing reduces routing cost per request, and BigQuery editions add opt-in compute cost attribution (Preview) that assigns billed slots to query projects based on actual reservation usage.

Date Post Source Summary

Snowflake on Medium The author demonstrates tracking Snowflake MCP server usage by assigning each server its own OAuth security integration and joining query history to login history, yielding usage per server, user, and day with one join.
